Name: Schooling
Effect: When this Pokémon is at half HP or less it will call for its allied Pokémon, when the allied Pokémon arrive replace the change to Wishiwashi School-Form at full HP. Increase its Rank two above your own. Restore Wishiwashi base Form at the end of the battle. Healing/Fainting/Recalling prevents the allied Pokémon from arriving. Unique Ability.
Description: When this Pokémon is threatened, it calls thousands of allies to create an uncontrollable monster. The closer to the sea, the faster they arrive.
